children: may retest a resistance at $97.71 per barrel, as it has more or less recovered from a drop to the Sept. 4 low of $93.15.
The recovery suggests a continuation of the uptrend from $86.22, which consists of five waves. The wave (5) is driving the market.
Support is at $95.52, a break below which may trigger a fall into the range of $93.55-$94.53, as the break would signal an extension of the correction from $97.61.
On the daily chart, the contract has completed a pullback toward a wedge and is poised to test the resistance at $97.95. A break could open the way toward $102.62.
The wedge indicates a much higher target of $117. It is not very clear whether the market could break $97.95 at its first attempt.
Considering that the former resistance at $94.18 caused a correction, the contract may fail to overcome the barrier at $97.95 over the next one or two days.
